author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: Departments agree with most recommendations, and agreement predicts implementation: disagreed recommendations are rarely implemented.
paragraphs: Agreement is the department's formal response at publication. The grid crosses response with eventual status. The bottom-left cell (agreed, never implemented) is the accountability gap; the top-right (disagreed, implemented anyway) is rare and usually follows a Board hearing.
Disagreeing is legitimate and sometimes right; the report page shows each department's reasons.

templates.template: {recs_fmt} recommendations, {years}: departments agreed with {agree_share}, partially agreed with {partial_share}, disagreed with {disagree_share}. Among agreed recommendations {impl_agreed} were implemented; among disagreed, {impl_disagreed}.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.
